queries.sourceKql:
union 
isfuzzy = true
(DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type= "DeviceInfo" | extend Description = "Machine information (including OS information)"),
(DeviceNetworkInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceNetworkInfo"  | extend Description = "Network properties of machines"),
(DeviceProcessEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceProcessEvents" | extend Description = "Process creation and related events"),
(DeviceNetworkEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceNetworkEvents" | extend Description = "Network connection and related events"),
(DeviceFileEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceFileEvents" | extend Description = "File creation, modification, and other file system events"),
(DeviceRegistryEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceRegistryEvents" | extend Description = "Creation and modification of registry entries"),
(DeviceLogonEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceLogonEvents" | extend Description = "Sign-ins and other authentication events"),
(DeviceImageLoadEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceImageLoadEvents" | extend Description = "DLL loading events"),
(DeviceEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceEvents" | extend Description = "Additional events types"),
(DeviceFileCertificateInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceFileCertificateInfo" | extend Description = "Certificate information of signed files)")
| extend ["Last Log Received At (Local Time)"] = TimeGenerated
| project Type, Description, ["Last Log Received At (Local Time)"]

queries.sourceKql:
let UsbDriveMount = DeviceEvents
| where ActionType=="UsbDriveMounted"
| extend ParsedFields=parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, DriveLetter=ParsedFields.DriveLetter, MountTime=Timestamp,
ProductName=ParsedFields.ProductName,SerialNumber=ParsedFields.SerialNumber,Manufacturer=ParsedFields.Manufacturer
| order by DeviceId asc, MountTime desc;
let FileCreation = DeviceFileEvents
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName != "system"
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FolderPath !startswith "C:\\"
| where FolderPath !startswith "\\"
| project ReportId,DeviceId,InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
InitiatingProcessAccountName,InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, Timestamp, SensitivityLabel, IsAzureInfoProtectionApplied
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc;
FileCreation | lookup kind=inner (UsbDriveMount) on DeviceId
| where FolderPath startswith DriveLetter
| where Timestamp >= MountTime
| partition by ReportId ( top 1 by MountTime )
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc
| summarize FileCount = count() by DeviceName
| order by FileCount desc
queries.queryKql:
let UsbDriveMount = DeviceEvents
| where ActionType=="UsbDriveMounted"
| extend ParsedFields=parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, DriveLetter=ParsedFields.DriveLetter, MountTime=Timestamp,
ProductName=ParsedFields.ProductName,SerialNumber=ParsedFields.SerialNumber,Manufacturer=ParsedFields.Manufacturer
| order by DeviceId asc, MountTime desc;
let FileCreation = DeviceFileEvents
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName != "system"
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FolderPath !startswith "C:\\"
| where FolderPath !startswith "\\"
| project ReportId,DeviceId,InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
InitiatingProcessAccountName,InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, Timestamp, SensitivityLabel, IsAzureInfoProtectionApplied
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc;
FileCreation | lookup kind=inner (UsbDriveMount) on DeviceId
| where FolderPath startswith DriveLetter
| where Timestamp >= MountTime
| partition by ReportId ( top 1 by MountTime )
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc
| summarize FileCount = count() by DeviceName
| order by FileCount desc

let data = IdentityLogonEvents
| where LogonType == "Credentials validation"
| extend TO_DEVICE = tostring(AdditionalFields.["TO.DEVICE"])
| extend Count = toint(AdditionalFields.Count);
data
| summarize sum(Count) by  TO_DEVICE
| order by sum_Count desc
| join kind=inner
(
data
| make-series Trend = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain} by TO_DEVICE
)
on $left.TO_DEVICE == $right.TO_DEVICE

queries.sourceKql:
//Per detection technology: the share of its quarantined emails later released from quarantine (a high rate can indicate false positives). Top 7 by release rate; detectors with <10 quarantined excluded so the rate is meaningful.
EmailEvents
| where DeliveryLocation == "Quarantine"
| extend MDO_detection = parse_json(DetectionMethods)
| extend FirstDetection = iif(isempty(MDO_detection), "Clean", tostring(bag_keys(MDO_detection)[0]))
| extend FirstSubcategory = iif(FirstDetection != "Clean" and array_length(MDO_detection[FirstDetection]) > 0, strcat(FirstDetection, ": ", tostring(MDO_detection[FirstDetection][0])), "No Detection (clean)")
| where FirstSubcategory contains "Malware" or FirstSubcategory contains "Phish"
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailPostDeliveryEvents
    | where Action == "Quarantine release"
    | distinct NetworkMessageId
    | extend ReleasedFlag = "yes"
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| summarize Quarantined = dcount(NetworkMessageId), Released = dcountif(NetworkMessageId, ReleasedFlag == "yes") by FirstSubcategory
| where Quarantined >= 10 and Released > 0
| extend ReleaseRate = round(Released * 100.0 / Quarantined, 2)
| project ['Detection Technology']=FirstSubcategory, ['Quarantined Emails']=Quarantined, ['Released']=Released, ['Release %']=ReleaseRate
| order by ['Release %'] desc
| take 7

queries.sourceKql:
//This query surfaces the users most targeted by inbound email threats across all threat types (malware, phishing, spam) for the selected period, so SecOps can prioritise the highest-risk individuals. Similar to a "Most Attacked People" view.
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize
    ['Total Threats'] = count(),
    Malware = countif(ThreatTypes has "Malware"),
    Phish   = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"),
    Spam    = countif(ThreatTypes has "Spam"),
    ['Last Seen'] = max(Timestamp)

let baseQuery = materialize(EmailEvents
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , "-", RecipientEmailAddress)

| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , "-", RecipientEmailAddress)

| join kind=leftouter (agg) on Timestamp, MalwareMethod
| project Timestamp, MalwareMethod, Count = coalesce(Count, 0)
| sort by MalwareMethod asc, Timestamp asc

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Malware detections summarizing the data by email sender IP address (SenderIPv4).
EmailEvents 
| where ThreatTypes has 'Malware' and isnotempty(SenderIPv4)
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize count() by SenderIPv4
| extend GeoInfo = geo_info_from_ip_address(SenderIPv4)
| extend Latitude = tostring(GeoInfo.latitude), Longitude = tostring(GeoInfo.longitude)
| project SenderIPv4, Latitude, Longitude, count_

| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"

| summarize Emails = arg_max(EmailCount, RecipientEmailAddress) by ThreatClassification
| sort by Emails desc
| project ['Threat Classification'] = ThreatClassification, ['Top Recipient'] = RecipientEmailAddress, ['Emails'] = Emails

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Phish detections summarized by individual Phish detection technology/control in Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
//Each detection technology is counted individually via mv-expand over DetectionMethods.Phish (matching the sibling trend line chart), so a message flagged by multiple techniques counts once per technique.
//The where clause excludes deliveries to the SecOps Mailbox and by the Phish Simulation system.
EmailEvents 
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| where DetectionMethods has "Phish"
| mv-expand Details = parse_json(DetectionMethods).Phish to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Details)
| summarize Count = count() by Details
| sort by Count desc
| project ['Detection Technology'] = Details, ['Detections'] = Count

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Phish detections summarizing the data by the top 15 email sender P2 domain (SenderFromDomain), now including the Phish confidence split (High/Normal) and the aggregated phish detection methods seen per domain. Adding additional insights for total inbound emails and bad traffic percentage for each sender domain.
//The comment in the query excludes deliveries to the SecOps Mailbox and by the Phish Simulation system. Remove the "//" to apply the exclusion.
EmailEvents
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| extend PhishConf = tostring(parse_json(ConfidenceLevel).Phish)
| extend PhishMethods = parse_json(DetectionMethods).Phish
| summarize TotalEmailCount = count(),
            PhishEmailCount = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"),
            Phish_High = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish" and PhishConf == "High"),
            Phish_Normal = countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish" and PhishConf == "Normal"),
            PhishMethodSet = make_set_if(PhishMethods, ThreatTypes has "Phish") by SenderFromDomain
| extend Bad_Traffic_Percentage_Inbound = todouble(round(PhishEmailCount / todouble(TotalEmailCount) * 100, 2))
| where PhishEmailCount != 0
| top 15 by PhishEmailCount
| mv-apply S = PhishMethodSet on ( mv-expand m = S to typeof(string) | summarize Methods = make_set(m) )
| project ['Sender Domain'] = SenderFromDomain, ['Phish Emails'] = PhishEmailCount, ['Phish (High)'] = Phish_High, ['Phish (Normal)'] = Phish_Normal, ['Total Inbound'] = TotalEmailCount, ['Bad Traffic %'] = Bad_Traffic_Percentage_Inbound, ['Detection Methods'] = strcat_array(Methods, ", ")

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Spam detections over time summarizing the data daily.
let gran = {Granularity};
let agg = materialize(EmailEvents 
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| where ThreatTypes has "Spam"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize Count = count() by Timestamp = bin(Timestamp, gran));
range Timestamp from toscalar(agg | summarize min(Timestamp)) to toscalar(agg | summarize max(Timestamp)) step gran
| join kind=leftouter (agg) on Timestamp
| project Timestamp, SpamDetections = coalesce(Count, 0)
| sort by Timestamp asc

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises top outbound recipient domains by outbound email volume and shows total number of inbound emails with Threats from the same domains (as inbound senders) 
EmailEvents
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
| project RecipientDomain = tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[1])
| summarize count() by RecipientDomain
| project OutboundCount=count_, RecipientDomain, SenderFromDomain=RecipientDomain
| join (EmailEvents | where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and isempty(ThreatTypes)==false) on SenderFromDomain
| summarize max(OutboundCount),count() by SenderFromDomain
| project SenderFromDomain, OutboundEmails=max_OutboundCount, IncomingEmailsWithThreats=count_
| extend Bad_Traffic_Percentage = todouble(round(IncomingEmailsWithThreats / todouble(OutboundEmails) * 100, 2))
| top 15 by OutboundEmails
| project ['Sender Domain'] = SenderFromDomain, ['Outbound Emails'] = OutboundEmails, ['Inbound w/ Threats'] = IncomingEmailsWithThreats, ['Bad Traffic %'] = Bad_Traffic_Percentage

queries.sourceKql:
//Top recipients targeted by impersonation / BEC, with distinct senders, spoofed domains and how many landed in the inbox.
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| where OrgLevelPolicy !in ("Phishing simulation", "SecOps Mailbox")
| where DetectionMethods has "Impersonation"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId, "-", RecipientEmailAddress)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize ImpersonationEmails = count(),
            DistinctSenders      = dcount(SenderFromAddress),
            TopSpoofedDomains    = make_set(SenderFromDomain, 5),
            DeliveredToInbox     = countif(DeliveryLocation has "Inbox")
        by RecipientEmailAddress
| top 20 by ImpersonationEmails
| project ['Recipient'] = RecipientEmailAddress, ['Impersonation Emails'] = ImpersonationEmails, ['Distinct Senders'] = DistinctSenders, ['Top Spoofed Domains'] = strcat_array(TopSpoofedDomains, ", "), ['Delivered to Inbox'] = DeliveredToInbox

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Spoof-DMARC fails detections summarizing the data by the top 10 email sender P2 domain (SenderFromDomain) and sender P1 domain (SenderMailFromDomain). Adding additional insights for total inbound emails and DMARC fail traffic percentage for each sender domain.
EmailEvents
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
| summarize TotalEmailCount = count(),
            DMARCFailCount = countif(set_has_element(parse_json(DetectionMethods).Phish, "Spoof DMARC")) by P1Sender=SenderMailFromDomain, P2Sender=SenderFromDomain
| extend DMARCFail_Traffic_Percentage = todouble(round(DMARCFailCount / todouble(TotalEmailCount) * 100, 2))
| where DMARCFailCount !=0
| top 10 by DMARCFailCount
| project ['P1 Sender'] = P1Sender, ['P2 Sender'] = P2Sender, ['DMARC Failures'] = DMARCFailCount, ['Total Inbound'] = TotalEmailCount, ['DMARC Fail %'] = DMARCFail_Traffic_Percentage

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises total emails with Malware detections over time summarizing the data daily by various Malware URL threat based detection technologies/controls in Microsoft Defender for Office 365.
let gran = {Granularity};
let agg = materialize(EmailEvents
| where DetectionMethods has 'Malware'
| where OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| extend ParsedMethods = parse_json(DetectionMethods)
| mv-expand MalwareMethod = ParsedMethods.Malware
| where MalwareMethod contains "URL"
| summarize Count = count() by MalwareMethod = tostring(MalwareMethod), Timestamp = bin(Timestamp, gran));
range Timestamp from toscalar(agg | summarize min(Timestamp)) to toscalar(agg | summarize max(Timestamp)) step gran
| extend d = 1 | join kind=inner (agg | distinct MalwareMethod | extend d = 1) on d | project Timestamp, MalwareMethod
| join kind=leftouter (agg) on Timestamp, MalwareMethod
| project Timestamp, MalwareMethod, Count = coalesce(Count, 0)
| sort by MalwareMethod asc, Timestamp asc

queries.sourceKql:
//Headline Microsoft Teams protection metrics for the selected period, with per-interval sparklines. Messages are de-duplicated to the latest record per Teams message.
let gran = {Granularity};
let msgs = materialize(MessageEvents | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by TeamsMessageId);
let zap = materialize(MessagePostDeliveryEvents);
union
(msgs | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Teams Messages Scanned", Ord = 1, Trend = toscalar(msgs | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(msgs | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Messages with Threats", Ord = 2, Trend = toscalar(msgs | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Phish" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Phish Detections", Ord = 3, Trend = toscalar(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Phish" | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Malware" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Malware Detections", Ord = 4, Trend = toscalar(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Malware" | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Spam" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Spam Detections", Ord = 5, Trend = toscalar(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Spam" | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(msgs | where SafetyTip == "URLMessageWarning" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Messages with URL Warning", Ord = 6, Trend = toscalar(msgs | where SafetyTip == "URLMessageWarning" | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S)),
(zap | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Post-Delivery ZAP Actions", Ord = 7, Trend = toscalar(zap | make-series S = count() default = 0 on Timestamp step gran | project S))
| sort by Ord asc
| project Details, Count, Trend

//This query breaks down Microsoft Teams threat detections by threat type for the selected period, de-duplicated to the latest record per message. A message flagged for more than one threat type is counted under each, so the split can exceed the distinct message count.
let msgs = MessageEvents | where isnotempty(ThreatTypes) | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by TeamsMessageId;
union
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Phish" | summarize Count = count() | extend ThreatType = "Phish"),
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Malware" | summarize Count = count() | extend ThreatType = "Malware"),
(msgs | where ThreatTypes has "Spam" | summarize Count = count() | extend ThreatType = "Spam")
| project ThreatType, Count

//Teams calls by start hour of day (UTC), all 24 hours 00:00..23:00 in order (interim source: CloudAppEvents / CallParticipantDetail).
let data = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "CallParticipantDetail"
| extend R = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend JoinTime = todatetime(R.JoinTime), CallId = tostring(R.CallId)

| summarize CallStart = min(JoinTime) by CallId
| extend HourUTC = hourofday(CallStart)
| summarize Calls = count() by HourUTC;
range HourUTC from 0 to 23 step 1

| extend Calls = coalesce(Calls, 0)

| order by HourUTC asc
| project ['Hour of Day (UTC)'] = HourLabel, ['Teams Calls'] = Calls

queries.sourceKql:
//Suspicious Teams callers by impersonation-style DISPLAY NAME or address (Attendees[].DisplayName / UPN), with Origin from the org's own accepted (EmailEvents inbound) domains - no tenant-id anchor. Interim source: CloudAppEvents / CallParticipantDetail.
let suspRegex = @"(?i)help ?desk|helpdesk|it ?support|service ?desk|sys ?admin|administrator|security|microsoft|google|apple|amazon|paypal|support|update|verif|account|password|mfa|maintenance";
let ownDomains = toscalar(EmailEvents | where EmailDirection == "Inbound" | extend RD = tolower(tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[1])) | where isnotempty(RD) | summarize make_set(RD, 200));
let calls = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "CallParticipantDetail"
| extend R = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend CallId = tostring(R.CallId), JoinTime = todatetime(R.JoinTime), Attendees = R.Attendees
| where isnotempty(CallId);
let callAtt = calls | summarize Attendees = take_any(Attendees), JoinTime = min(JoinTime) by CallId;
callAtt
| mv-expand Att = Attendees
| extend Caller = tolower(tostring(Att.UPN)), CallerName = tostring(Att.DisplayName)

queries.sourceKql:
//External Teams senders flagged as likely impersonation: throwaway .onmicrosoft.com tenants and/or help desk / IT / admin / update-themed display names, ranked by messages carrying a threat.
MessageEvents
| where IsExternalThread == true
| extend SenderDomain = tolower(tostring(split(SenderEmailAddress, "@")[1]))
| extend IsOnMicrosoft = SenderDomain endswith ".onmicrosoft.com"
| extend SuspName = SenderDisplayName matches regex @"(?i)help ?desk|helpdesk|it ?support|service ?desk|it team|administrator|sys ?admin|security|microsoft|maintenance|support|update|verif|account|password|mfa"
| where IsOnMicrosoft or SuspName
| summarize TeamsMessages = count(), ThreatMessages = countif(isnotempty(ThreatTypes)), FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by SenderDisplayName, SenderEmailAddress, SenderDomain, IsOnMicrosoft, SuspName
| extend WhyFlagged = case(IsOnMicrosoft and SuspName, "Throwaway .onmicrosoft tenant + helpdesk-style name", IsOnMicrosoft, "Throwaway .onmicrosoft tenant", "Helpdesk / IT-style display name")
| extend ThreatPct = round(todouble(ThreatMessages) * 100 / TeamsMessages, 1)
| project ['Sender Display Name']=SenderDisplayName, ['Sender Address']=SenderEmailAddress, ['Why Flagged']=WhyFlagged, ['Teams Messages']=TeamsMessages, ['Threat Messages']=ThreatMessages, ['Threat %']=ThreatPct, ['First Seen']=FirstSeen, ['Last Seen']=LastSeen
| sort by ['Threat Messages'] desc, ['Teams Messages'] desc
| take 10

         FakeDisplayName   = tostring(RD.Sender.DisplayName),
         FakeSenderAddress = tostring(RD.Sender.UPN),
         TargetUser        = tostring(RD.UserId)
| extend FakeSenderDomain = tostring(split(FakeSenderAddress, "@")[1]);
imp
| summarize Detections=count(), SenderAddresses=dcount(FakeSenderAddress), Targets=dcount(TargetUser), FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by FakeDisplayName, FakeSenderDomain, ImpersonationType
| top 10 by Detections
| project ['Fake Display Name']=FakeDisplayName, ['Sender Domain']=FakeSenderDomain, ['Impersonation Type']=ImpersonationType, ['Distinct Sender Addresses']=SenderAddresses, Detections, ['Targeted Users']=Targets, ['First Seen']=FirstSeen, ['Last Seen']=LastSeen

queries.sourceKql:
//This query lists URL domains that appeared in messages sent by impersonating senders, with a breakdown of how many carried Malware, Phish, or Spam verdicts. Threat actors mix legitimate and malicious domains in a single lure, so review the unfamiliar or look-alike domains and block only confirmed-malicious ones.
let imp = CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "TeamsImpersonationDetected"
| extend RD = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend ChatThreadId = tostring(RD.ChatThreadId);
let impThreads = imp | distinct ChatThreadId;
let impMsgs = MessageEvents
    | where ThreadId in (impThreads)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by TeamsMessageId
    | project TeamsMessageId, ThreatTypes;
MessageUrlInfo
| where isnotempty(UrlDomain)
| join kind=inner (impMsgs) on TeamsMessageId
| summarize ['URL Count']=count(), Messages=dcount(TeamsMessageId), Malware=countif(ThreatTypes has "Malware"), Phish=countif(ThreatTypes has "Phish"), Spam=countif(ThreatTypes has "Spam") by ['URL Domain']=UrlDomain
| top 10 by ['URL Count']

//This query lists the top 10 users receiving Microsoft Teams messages that contained a threat, expanded from the message recipient list, with each user's total Teams messages received and the share that carried a threat. Messages are de-duplicated to the latest record per message.
let expanded = MessageEvents
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by TeamsMessageId
    | mv-expand rd = parse_json(RecipientDetails)
    | extend Recipient = tostring(rd.RecipientSmtpAddress)
    | where isnotempty(Recipient);
let totals = expanded | summarize TotalMessages = count() by Recipient;
expanded
| where isnotempty(ThreatTypes)
| summarize ThreatMessages = count() by Recipient
| join kind=leftouter (totals) on Recipient
| extend ThreatPct = round(100.0 * ThreatMessages / TotalMessages, 1)
| top 10 by ThreatMessages
| project ['Recipient']=Recipient, ['Threat Messages']=ThreatMessages, ['Total Messages']=TotalMessages, ['Threat %']=ThreatPct

queries.sourceKql:
//This query lists URL domains shared in Microsoft Teams that use low-reputation TLDs commonly abused for phishing and malware, ranked by the number of Teams messages they appeared in, with first- and last-seen. Treat high-reach or newly-seen domains as candidate indicators of compromise.
let suspTlds = dynamic(["top","xyz","click","link","shop","online","site","live","icu","cyou","sbs","rest","quest","cfd","bond","buzz","fun","space","monster","work","tk","ml","ga","cf","gq","dev","app","zip","mov","info","win","loan","men","stream","country"]);
MessageUrlInfo
| where isnotempty(UrlDomain)
| extend Tld = tostring(split(UrlDomain, ".")[-1])
| where Tld in (suspTlds)
| summarize Messages=dcount(TeamsMessageId), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by ['URL Domain']=UrlDomain, ['TLD']=Tld
| top 10 by Messages desc

| sort by Ord asc
| project Count, Details

let sub = materialize(CloudAppEvents

(sub | where SubmissionContentType == "ChatMessage" and ActionType == "UserSubmission" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Messages Reported by Users", Ord = 1),
(sub | where SubmissionContentType == "TeamsCall" and ActionType == "UserSubmission" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Calls Reported by Users", Ord = 2),
(sub | where SubmissionContentType == "ChatMessage" and ActionType == "AdminSubmission" | summarize Count = count() | extend Details = "Messages Submitted by Admins", Ord = 3)
| sort by Ord asc
| project Count, Details

//This query shows the mix of Microsoft Teams submissions by content type and reporter for the selected period. Only completed user submissions (chat and call) and admin submissions (chat) are counted; submission triage/timeout lifecycle records are excluded.

| extend RD = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend RecordType = tostring(RD.RecordType), SubmissionContentType = tostring(RD.SubmissionContentType)

    or (SubmissionContentType == "ChatMessage" and ActionType == "AdminSubmission")
| extend Reporter = iif(ActionType == "AdminSubmission", "Admin", "User")
| summarize Count = count() by SubmissionType = strcat(SubmissionContentType, " (", Reporter, ")")

queries.sourceKql:
// This query visualises the top 10 users that are receiving Spam, Phishing or Malware emails
EmailEvents 
| where  OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox" and EmailDirection =="Inbound"
| extend MDO_detection = parse_json(DetectionMethods) 
| extend FirstDetection = iif(isempty(MDO_detection), "Clean", tostring(bag_keys(MDO_detection)[0])) 
| extend FirstSubcategory = iif(FirstDetection != "Clean" and array_length(MDO_detection[FirstDetection]) > 0, strcat(FirstDetection, ": ", tostring(MDO_detection[FirstDetection][0])), "No Detection (clean)") 
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize TotalEmailCount=count(),MalwareEmailCount = countif(FirstDetection == "Malware"),PhishEmailCount = countif(FirstDetection ==  "Phish"),SpamEmailCount = countif(FirstDetection ==  "Spam") by RecipientEmailAddress
| extend ThreatEmailCount=(MalwareEmailCount+PhishEmailCount+SpamEmailCount)
| extend Bad_Traffic_Percentage_Inbound = todouble(round(ThreatEmailCount / todouble(TotalEmailCount) *100, 2))
| top 15 by ThreatEmailCount
| project ['Recipient']=RecipientEmailAddress, ['Total Emails']=TotalEmailCount, ['Threat Emails']=ThreatEmailCount, ['Malware']=MalwareEmailCount, ['Phish']=PhishEmailCount, ['Spam']=SpamEmailCount, ['Bad Traffic %']=Bad_Traffic_Percentage_Inbound

queries.sourceKql:
//This query visualises the ammount of emails subject to an admin policy with action of allow independent of action taken, summarizing the data daily
let gran = {Granularity};
let agg = materialize(EmailEvents
| where isnotempty(OrgLevelPolicy) and OrgLevelPolicy!="SecOps Mailbox" and OrgLevelAction == "Allow"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId , '-', RecipientEmailAddress) 
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize TotalAdminOverrides = count() by Timestamp = bin(Timestamp, gran));
range Timestamp from toscalar(agg | summarize min(Timestamp)) to toscalar(agg | summarize max(Timestamp)) step gran
| join kind=leftouter (agg) on Timestamp
| project Timestamp, ['Admin Overrides'] = coalesce(TotalAdminOverrides, 0)
| sort by Timestamp asc

queries.sourceKql:
//Top recipients receiving threats that were delivered due to an admin or user override, with the share of their threats that were overridden and a breakdown of which override types caused them.
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and OrgLevelPolicy != "Phishing simulation" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox"
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId, "-", RecipientEmailAddress)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| extend OverrideType = case(
    OrgLevelAction == "Allow" and OrgLevelPolicy != "" and OrgLevelPolicy != "SecOps Mailbox", OrgLevelPolicy,
    UserLevelAction == "Allow", strcat("User: ", UserLevelPolicy),
    "(none)")
| summarize PerType = count() by RecipientEmailAddress, OverrideType
| summarize TotalThreats = sum(PerType),
            OverriddenThreats = sumif(PerType, OverrideType != "(none)"),
            OverrideTypes = strcat_array(make_set_if(strcat(OverrideType, " (", PerType, ")"), OverrideType != "(none)"), "; ")
        by RecipientEmailAddress
| where OverriddenThreats > 0
| extend OverridePercent = round(OverriddenThreats * 100.0 / TotalThreats, 1)
| top 15 by OverriddenThreats
| project ['Recipient']=RecipientEmailAddress, ['Total Threats']=TotalThreats, ['Overridden Threats']=OverriddenThreats, ['Override %']=OverridePercent, ['Override Types']=OverrideTypes

//This query visualises user submissions where admin also performed 'mark and notify' action on the submission
let ReviewResults = CloudAppEvents | where ActionType == "SubmissionNotification" 
| extend SubmissionId = tostring(parse_json(RawEventData).SubmissionId)
| extend Properties = parse_json(RawEventData.ExtendedProperties)
| mv-expand element = Properties
| where element.Name == "AdminReviewResult"
| project SubmissionId, AdminReviewResult = element.Value;
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "UserSubmission"
| extend SubmissionId = tostring(parse_json(RawEventData).SubmissionId), SubmissionType = parse_json(RawEventData).SubmissionType
| join kind=leftouter ReviewResults on SubmissionId
| extend UserReportedAs=iif(SubmissionType == 1, "Phish",iif(SubmissionType == 2, "Junk",iif(SubmissionType == 3, "NotJunk","")))
| extend ReviewedAccuracy=iif(UserReportedAs==AdminReviewResult, 1,0)
| extend Reviewed=iif(isempty(AdminReviewResult),"Not Reviewed","Reviewed")
| project SubmissionId,UserReportedAs,Reviewed,AdminReviewResult, ReviewedAccuracy
| summarize count() by Reviewed

queries.sourceKql:
//Admin false positive submissions whose original verdict was Malware, grouped by the detection method that flagged them. A high count means that method most often misclassifies legitimate mail as Malware.
let total = toscalar(CloudAppEvents
    | where ActionType == "AdminSubmissionSubmitted"
    | extend R = parse_json(RawEventData)
    | where tostring(R.SubmissionContentType) == "Mail" and tostring(R.SubmissionType) == "3" and tostring(R.DeliveryMessageInfo.FinalFilterVerdict) == "Malware"
    | count);
CloudAppEvents
| where ActionType == "AdminSubmissionSubmitted"
| extend R = parse_json(RawEventData)
| extend SubmissionType = tostring(R.SubmissionType), SubmissionContentType = tostring(R.SubmissionContentType), DetectionMethod = tostring(R.DeliveryMessageInfo.FinalFilterVerdictControlSource), DetectionVerdict = tostring(R.DeliveryMessageInfo.FinalFilterVerdict), P2SenderDomain = tostring(R.P2SenderDomain)
| where SubmissionContentType == "Mail" and SubmissionType == "3" and DetectionVerdict == "Malware"
| extend DetectionMethod = iif(isempty(DetectionMethod), "Not specified", DetectionMethod)
| summarize FPSubmissions = count(), DistinctDomains = dcount(P2SenderDomain) by DetectionMethod
| extend Pct = iif(total == 0, 0.0, round(FPSubmissions * 100.0 / total, 1))
| sort by FPSubmissions desc
| project ['Detection Method'] = DetectionMethod, ['FP Submissions'] = FPSubmissions, ['Distinct Sender Domains'] = DistinctDomains, ['% of Malware FPs'] = Pct

//This query summarizes File malware detections by Microsoft Defender for Office 365 (Safe Attachments detonation) into a per-family table: total detections, distinct files, affected locations (file owner or site) and when the family was last seen.
FileMaliciousContentInfo
| where tostring(DetectionMethods) contains "detonation"
| extend Owner = iff(isnotempty(FileOwnerUpn), FileOwnerUpn, strcat("Site: ", tostring(split(FolderPath, "/")[4])))
| summarize ['Files']=count(), ['Distinct Files']=dcount(SHA256), ['Affected Locations']=dcount(Owner), ['Last Seen']=max(Timestamp) by ThreatNames
| sort by ['Files'] desc
| project ['Threat Name']=ThreatNames, ['Files'], ['Distinct Files'], ['Affected Locations'], ['Last Seen']

FileMaliciousContentInfo
| where tostring(DetectionMethods) contains "detonation"
| extend Owner = iff(isnotempty(FileOwnerUpn), FileOwnerUpn, strcat("Site: ", tostring(split(FolderPath, "/")[4])))
| summarize ['Files']=count(), ['Distinct Files']=dcount(SHA256), ['Affected Locations']=dcount(Owner), ['Last Seen']=max(Timestamp) by ThreatNames
| sort by ['Files'] desc
| project ['Threat Name']=ThreatNames, ['Files'], ['Distinct Files'], ['Affected Locations'], ['Last Seen']

queries.sourceKql:
//Per detection technology: the share of its quarantined emails that were later released from quarantine.
//Release % = released / quarantined for that detection technology - a high rate flags a detector that may be over-flagging legitimate mail (potential false positives). Detectors with fewer than 10 quarantined emails are excluded so the rate is statistically meaningful.
EmailEvents
| where DeliveryLocation == "Quarantine"
| extend MDO_detection = parse_json(DetectionMethods)
| extend FirstDetection = iif(isempty(MDO_detection), "Clean", tostring(bag_keys(MDO_detection)[0]))
| extend FirstSubcategory = iif(FirstDetection != "Clean" and array_length(MDO_detection[FirstDetection]) > 0, strcat(FirstDetection, ": ", tostring(MDO_detection[FirstDetection][0])), "No Detection (clean)")
| where FirstSubcategory contains "Malware" or FirstSubcategory contains "Phish" or FirstSubcategory contains "Spam"
| join kind=leftouter (
    EmailPostDeliveryEvents
    | where Action == "Quarantine release"
    | distinct NetworkMessageId
    | extend ReleasedFlag = "yes"
  ) on NetworkMessageId
| summarize Quarantined = dcount(NetworkMessageId), Released = dcountif(NetworkMessageId, ReleasedFlag == "yes") by FirstSubcategory
| where Quarantined >= 10 and Released > 0
| extend ReleaseRate = round(Released * 100.0 / Quarantined, 2)
| project ['Detection Type']=FirstSubcategory, ['Quarantined Emails']=Quarantined, ['Released']=Released, ['Release %']=ReleaseRate
| order by ['Release %'] desc

queries.sourceKql:
// Filter for incidents that have at least one Email Security alert
let gran = {Granularity};
let OfficeEmailAlerts = SecurityAlert
    | where ProductName contains "Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection" or ProductName contains "Microsoft 365 Defender"
    | project SystemAlertId;
let agg = materialize(SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| mv-expand AlertIds
| where isnotempty(AlertIds) and not(Title startswith "CC_")
| extend AlertId = tostring(AlertIds) 
| join kind=inner
    (OfficeEmailAlerts | extend SystemAlertId = tostring(SystemAlertId))
    on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *), AlertCount = dcount(AlertId) by IncidentNumber
| summarize Incidents_Number = count() by TimeGenerated = bin(TimeGenerated, gran));
range TimeGenerated from toscalar(agg | summarize min(TimeGenerated)) to toscalar(agg | summarize max(TimeGenerated)) step gran
| join kind=leftouter (agg) on TimeGenerated
| project TimeGenerated, ['Email Security Incidents'] = coalesce(Incidents_Number, 0)
| sort by TimeGenerated asc

// Categorize incidents: Email Security vs Other
let AllAlerts = SecurityAlert
    | extend SystemAlertId = tostring(SystemAlertId)
    | project SystemAlertId, ProductName;
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| mv-expand AlertIds
| where isnotempty(AlertIds) and not(Title startswith "CC_")
| extend AlertId = tostring(AlertIds)
| join kind=inner
    (AllAlerts)
    on $left.AlertId == $right.SystemAlertId
| summarize AlertSystems = make_set(ProductName) by IncidentNumber
| extend HasEmailSecurity = 
    AlertSystems has "Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection" or 
    AlertSystems has "Microsoft 365 Defender"
| extend Category = iff(HasEmailSecurity, "Email Security", "Other")
| summarize IncidentCount = count() by Category

// SLA thresholds by severity for email-security (MDO) incidents
let SLA_Variables = datatable (Severity:string, TimeToResolve:int) [
    "High", 60,
    "Medium", 120,
    "Low", 240,
    "Informational", 480
];

// Identify MDO-related incidents via alert correlation
let EmailSecurityIncidents = 
    SecurityIncident
    | mv-expand AlertIds
    | where isnotempty(AlertIds)
    | extend AlertId = tostring(AlertIds)
    | join kind=inner (
        SecurityAlert
        | where ProductName in ("Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection", "Microsoft 365 Defender")
        | extend AlertId = tostring(SystemAlertId)
        | project AlertId
    ) on AlertId
    | distinct ProviderIncidentId;

// Get latest incident state for each MDO-related incident
let LatestMdoIncidents =
    SecurityIncident
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Classification, Status, Severity, CreatedTime, ClosedTime, Title) by ProviderIncidentId
    | where ProviderIncidentId in (EmailSecurityIncidents)
    | where not(Title startswith "CC_");  // Exclude non-email incidents as needed

LatestMdoIncidents
| where Status == "Closed"
| extend TimeToResolveIncident = datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime)
| join kind=inner SLA_Variables on Severity
| summarize
    ['Avg Time to Close (min)'] = avg(TimeToResolveIncident),
    CountIncidents = count(), Breached = countif(TimeToResolveIncident > TimeToResolve)
    by Day = bin(ClosedTime, 1d), Severity
| order by Day asc, Severity asc

// Build a list of MDO-related incidents by cross-referencing SecurityAlert
let EmailSecurityIncidents = SecurityIncident
    | mv-expand AlertIds
    | where isnotempty(AlertIds)
    | extend AlertId = tostring(AlertIds)
    | join kind=inner (
        SecurityAlert
        | where ProductName in ("Office 365 Advanced Threat Protection", "Microsoft 365 Defender")
        | extend AlertId = tostring(SystemAlertId)
        | project AlertId
    ) on AlertId
    | distinct ProviderIncidentId;

// Get only the most recent state of each incident, ensuring it's MDO-related
let LatestIncidents = SecurityIncident
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Classification, Status, Title) by ProviderIncidentId
    | where ProviderIncidentId in (EmailSecurityIncidents)
    | where not(Title startswith "CC_");  // Exclude incidents unrelated to MDO (e.g., DSPM)

queries.sourceKql:
// SOC metric: Daily average/p75 delay (in minutes) from email delivery to AIR action
let deliveries = EmailEvents
  | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"// delivered emails
  | extend MsgKey = strcat(NetworkMessageId, "-", RecipientEmailAddress)
  | summarize FirstDelivery = min(Timestamp) by MsgKey, Threat = tostring(ThreatTypes);
let remediations = EmailPostDeliveryEvents
  | where ActionType =~ "Automated Remediation"// automated remediation events
  | extend MsgKey = strcat(NetworkMessageId, "-", RecipientEmailAddress)
  | summarize FirstRemediation = min(Timestamp) by MsgKey;
deliveries
| join kind=inner remediations on MsgKey
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff("minute", FirstRemediation, FirstDelivery)
| where DelayMinutes >= 0
| summarize ['Avg (min)'] = avg(DelayMinutes),
            ['P80 (min)'] = percentile(DelayMinutes, 80),
            ['P90 (min)'] = percentile(DelayMinutes, 90),
            ['P99 (min)'] = percentile(DelayMinutes, 99),
            CountEmails = count()
   by bin(FirstRemediation, 1d)

queries.sourceKql:
// AIR investigation outcomes by day: ThreatDetected vs. Clean

// Step 1: Deduplicate automated remediation events by message and recipient
let AutoRemediations = 
    EmailPostDeliveryEvents
    | where ActionType == "Automated Remediation"
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, ActionResult) by NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress
    | project NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, Timestamp;

// Step 2: Derive threat verdicts using AlertEvidence
let EvidenceVerdicts =
    AlertEvidence
    | where EntityType in ("MailMessage", "MailCluster")
    | extend extra = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
    // If this is a mail cluster, use provided NetworkMessageIds array; otherwise wrap NetworkMessageId as a single-item array
    | extend networkIds = iff(
      isnull(extra.NetworkMessageIds) or array_length(extra.NetworkMessageIds) == 0,
      pack_array(NetworkMessageId),          // create a single-element array using pack_array
      extra.NetworkMessageIds                // use the array as-is if it exists
    )
    | mv-expand nmID = networkIds                // expand to individual message IDs
    // Derive verdict from LastVerdict, ThreatAnalysisSummary, and ThreatIntelligence
    | extend 
        lastVerdict = tolower(tostring(extra.LastVerdict)),
        threatAIList = extra.ThreatAnalysisSummary,
        threatInt   = extra.ThreatIntelligence
    | extend verdictFromAnalysis = iff(array_length(threatAIList) > 0, tolower(tostring(threatAIList[0].Verdict)), ""),
             verdictTI          = iff(array_length(threatInt) > 0, "malicious", "")   // any item in ThreatIntelligence indicates malicious
    // Mark as threat-detected if verdict is malicious/suspicious or threat evidence is present
    | extend ThreatDetectedFlag = 
        case(
            lastVerdict in ("malicious","suspicious") or verdictFromAnalysis in ("malicious","suspicious")
                or verdictTI == "malicious",
            true,
            false
        )
    // Weight mail clusters by MailCount; default to 1 for single messages
    | extend MailCountInt = toint(extra.MailCount)
    | extend Weight = iff(EntityType == "MailCluster", 
                        coalesce(MailCountInt, 1), // default to 1 if MailCount is missing
                        1)
    | summarize IsThreatDetected = any(ThreatDetectedFlag), 
                WeightSum       = sum(Weight) 
    by nmID = tostring(nmID);

// Step 3: Join remediation events with verdicts and aggregate by day
AutoRemediations
| join kind=leftouter EvidenceVerdicts on $left.NetworkMessageId == $right.nmID
| extend isThreat      = coalesce(IsThreatDetected, false), 
         effectiveWeight= coalesce(WeightSum, 1)
| extend InvestigationOutcome = iif(isThreat, "Threat Detected", "Clean")
| summarize PreventionCount = sum(effectiveWeight) by Day = bin(Timestamp, {Granularity}), InvestigationOutcome
| order by Day asc, InvestigationOutcome asc

queries.sourceKql:
//Largest malicious inbound email campaigns clustered by EmailClusterId - one row per attack wave (messages, recipients, URL clicks, sender domains, threat mix, sample subjects).
//URL Clicks = clicks by recipients on URLs within the campaign's messages (UrlClickEvents joined via NetworkMessageId).
let clicksByCluster = UrlClickEvents
| join kind=inner (EmailEvents | where EmailClusterId > 0 | distinct NetworkMessageId, EmailClusterId) on NetworkMessageId
| summarize UrlClicks = count() by EmailClusterId;
let qrClusters = EmailUrlInfo
| where UrlLocation == "QRCode"
| join kind=inner (EmailEvents | where EmailClusterId > 0 | distinct NetworkMessageId, EmailClusterId) on NetworkMessageId
| summarize QrMessages = dcount(NetworkMessageId) by EmailClusterId;
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Inbound" and isnotempty(ThreatTypes) and EmailClusterId > 0
| where OrgLevelPolicy !in ("Phishing simulation", "SecOps Mailbox")
| extend Key = strcat(NetworkMessageId, "-", RecipientEmailAddress)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, *) by Key
| summarize Messages = count(),
            Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress),
            SenderDomains = dcount(SenderFromDomain),
            SampleSenderDomains = make_set(SenderFromDomain, 5),
            ThreatTypesRaw = make_set(ThreatTypes, 50),
            SampleSubjects = make_set(Subject, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
        by EmailClusterId
| join kind=leftouter (clicksByCluster) on EmailClusterId
| extend UrlClicks = coalesce(UrlClicks, 0)
| join kind=leftouter (qrClusters) on EmailClusterId
| extend ['QR Code'] = iif(coalesce(QrMessages, 0) > 0, "QR code", "")
| extend ThreatMix = array_sort_asc(set_union(split(strcat_array(ThreatTypesRaw, ", "), ", "), dynamic([])))
| top 20 by Messages
| project ['Email Cluster ID']=EmailClusterId, ['Messages']=Messages, ['Recipients']=Recipients, ['URL Clicks']=UrlClicks, ['Sender Domains']=SenderDomains, ['Sample Sender Domains']=SampleSenderDomains, ['Threat Mix']=ThreatMix, ['QR Code']=['QR Code'], ['Sample Subjects']=SampleSubjects, ['First Seen']=FirstSeen, ['Last Seen']=LastSeen

sourceRecommendationEvidence.text:
The [Microsoft Defender XDR](https://www.microsoft.com/security/business/threat-protection/microsoft-365-defender) solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest Security Alerts/Incidents and raw logs from the products within Microsoft Defender XDR suite into Microsoft Sentinel.

Additional Hunting Queries to support proactive and reactive hunting for the Microsoft Defender XDR solution can be found on [GitHub](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Hunting%20Queries/Microsoft%20365%20Defender). This repository has a collection of queries developed by Microsoft Security Research and Microsoft Sentinel community contributions.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Azure Monitor HTTP Data Collector API](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/data-collector-api)
